author: first_agent
entrant: 2026-10-04: continue MAST q95/betaN variants; a DIII-D improvement is welcome
question: D4 (all scalar label weights x4) improved the scalar heads (li, kappa, R_axis, volume) but degraded the shared flux maps and boundary. Does taking only the scalar heads from such specialist networks, with the flux coordinates, X-point and boundary-radius outputs still from V0, keep the head gain without the map loss?
public_motivation: public DIII-D components vs the leading entry (.9963): our qb .99763 vs .9980, Consistency .98652 vs .9875, D_LCFS .00891 vs .0082. The finisher bends the maps to the scalar heads (shape: kappa, tri_top, tri_bot, volume, li; axis: r_axis, z_axis), so better heads can lift Consistency without touching the flux network.
design: Arm H only. Fold 0: V0 = kfold/oof_fold0 networks, specialist = d4/oof_fold0 networks (D4, x4 uniform). Fold 1: V0 = kfold/oof_fold1, specialist = d4b/oof_fold1 networks (D4b, x4 on li, li_scored, kappa, r_axis, volume). Labels taken from the specialist mean: q95, beta_n, li, li_scored, r_axis, z_axis, kappa, tri_top, tri_bot, volume (every scalar head; no per-scalar choice). Coordinates, x_lower/upper_r/z and lcfs_r_00..63 from V0. v25 finisher unchanged (kfold_build). Builder d6_build.py; same 80 shots per fold, same order.
metric: pooled S over folds 0+1 (160 shots), every 2nd frame, paired shot bootstrap 20000, seed 951 (d6_score.py, from d4c_score.py).
decision_rule: screen passes if pooled dS >= +2e-5 and P >= 0.8. Then a confirmation on unseen folds 2, 3, 4 with new D4-type specialist fits (uniform x4, recipe of D4) is frozen BEFORE any fold 2-4 result: adoption needs folds 2-4 dS >= +2e-5 and P >= 0.9. Otherwise rejected.
prior_exposure: D4 fold-0 and D4b fold-1 per-scalar and per-term results are known (ledger 2.14, 2.16): heads li/kappa/R_axis/volume up, tri and D_LCFS down with the specialists' own maps. The head-swap combination itself has not been built or scored. Because folds 0 and 1 are exposed, the screen cannot adopt anything alone; folds 2-4 decide.
compute: builds on the workstation CPU (5 workers, nice 5, single-threaded BLAS), as the D4c builds.
